name: Nardwuar FC
blurb: Research as protest, the receipt as weapon — a punk-zine archive worn as a host-nation home kit.

stages.title: The Mood
stages.blurb: Moodboards — the texture, palette and references the kit grows from.

images.caption: Tartan jersey on layered photocopied punk-flyer collage with ransom-note Nardwuar FC and protest-kit text
images.prompt: A layered wall of photocopied punk show flyers, overlapping, stapled and torn, riso red and green ink, microtype gig listings and venue names, underground archive texture, xerox grit. No faces.

images.caption: Red-green tartan panel ghosted over a punk-zine collage with ransom-note title block
images.prompt: Extreme macro of a woven tartan check — tartan red crossed with tartan green and a thin tartan-yellow overcheck — ghosted faint as if printed into matte sportswear jersey fabric, fine sett detail, heritage textile precision, official home-kit gravity. Full-bleed.

stages.title: The Marks
stages.blurb: Crests, patterns, nameplates, numbers and typography — the language of the kit.

images.caption: Repeating riso-collage all-over print tile: tartan, cassettes, mic, vinyl and Nardwuar FC ransom text
images.prompt: A seamless repeating pattern, an ultra-faint collage of VHS labels, cassette J-card spines, 7-inch record labels and photocopied flyer scraps, tonal tartan-red and green riso ink, microtype interview quotes woven through, a tight repeat for sublimated jersey fabric, walking-archive texture. No faces. white background.

images.caption: Embroidered round patch 'Deep Research / Human Serviette Reporting Club' with tartan, newsprint and mic
images.prompt: An official "Fair Play" style circular badge, reads "DEEP RESEARCH" arched over "HUMAN SERVIETTE REPORTING CLUB", tartan-green border, bone field, small enough for a sleeve, styled like a tournament fair-play badge. white background.

images.caption: Number 97 filled with red-green record sleeves, cassettes, tam, mic and zine panels
images.prompt: A large athletic jersey number "97" composed of tiny rectangles, each a miniature record sleeve or zine panel, tartan-red and green fills, vinyl-black outline, a clean modern number silhouette built from collage tiles. white background.

images.caption: Jersey hem microprint citation: 'APEC Vancouver 1997 / Nardwuar to PM Chretien on pepper spray'
images.prompt: Dense technical microtext for a jersey hem, reads "APEC VANCOUVER 1997 · NARDWUAR TO PM CHRETIEN ON PEPPER SPRAY · 'FOR ME, PEPPER, I PUT IT ON MY PLATE'" in tiny monospace, tartan-red text on bone, professional fine-print aesthetic. white background.

images.caption: Riso-collage all-over print: SUPPORT LOCAL MUSIC, KEEP VANCOUVER WEIRD, RESEARCH IS THE PROTEST
images.prompt: A seamless repeating pattern, an ultra-faint collage of VHS labels, cassette J-card spines, 7-inch record labels and photocopied flyer scraps, tonal tartan-red and green riso ink, microtype interview quotes woven through, a tight repeat for sublimated jersey fabric, walking-archive texture. No faces. white background.

images.caption: Cream plaid towel-banner reading WHO BENEFITS? WHO PAYS? in red with accountability microtext and beret
images.prompt: A professional sponsor bar / brand bar, text reads "WHO BENEFITS? WHO PAYS?", styled like an official sports sponsor wordmark, clean sans-serif, tartan red on a bone rectangle, official tournament sponsor aesthetic. white background.

images.caption: Round green-tartan badge: DEEP RESEARCH / HUMAN SERVIETTE REPORTING CLUB around a beret-topped mic
images.prompt: An official "Fair Play" style circular badge, reads "DEEP RESEARCH" arched over "HUMAN SERVIETTE REPORTING CLUB", tartan-green border, bone field, small enough for a sleeve, styled like a tournament fair-play badge. white background.

images.caption: Hem microprint citation: APEC VANCOUVER 1997 Nardwuar pepper-spray quote on cream fabric
images.prompt: Dense technical microtext for a jersey hem, reads "APEC VANCOUVER 1997 · NARDWUAR TO PM CHRETIEN ON PEPPER SPRAY · 'FOR ME, PEPPER, I PUT IT ON MY PLATE'" in tiny monospace, tartan-red text on bone, professional fine-print aesthetic. white background.

stages.title: The Flats
stages.blurb: Technical jersey flats — front, back, the complete kit laid out.

images.caption: Front and back jersey flats in pale tartan with ghosted record collage, mic crest and number 7
images.prompt: A seamless tartan check pattern, tartan red crossed with tartan green and a thin tartan-yellow overcheck, a clean heritage sett ghosted soft as a sublimated jersey base, official home-kit textile aesthetic. white background.

images.caption: Newsprint-microtext kit set with shield crest, tam, mic stand, tartan accents, shorts and socks
images.prompt: A repeating layer of tiny monospace microtext, faint underground-history notes and interview quotes, tonal toner-black on bone, a subtle ornamental document layer. white background.

images.caption: Home jersey front flat: red-green tartan, mic crest, WHO BENEFITS? WHO PAYS? box
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a unisex soccer jersey, host-nation home-kit silhouette with bold classic striping, tartan-red body with green and yellow tartan check ghosted into the fabric, an ultra-faint all-over collage of records, flyers and microtext beneath the check, a collage crest on the left chest (host-city shield, records and a tam silhouette, no face), a center-chest sponsor bar reading "WHO BENEFITS? WHO PAYS?". Clean line work, high detail, ready for production. white background.

images.caption: Home jersey back flat: ransom-note NARDWUAR!!, number 97 from record/cassette collage on red tartan
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of the jersey back, tartan-red body, ghosted check and faint riso-collage continuing, a large nameplate reading "NARDWUAR!!" in cut-and-paste ransom-note type, a number "97" below composed of tiny record-sleeve and zine-panel rectangles, narrow tartan-green shoulder trim, a fine hem microprint citation line. white background.

images.caption: Away jersey back: ransom-note WHO ARE YOU? / DOOT DOOLA DOOT DOO, number 9 collage on bone tartan
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of the jersey back, a bone newsprint body with red/green tartan trim, back text reading "WHO ARE YOU?" above "DOOT DOOLA DOOT DOO" in cut-and-paste lettering, a number from record-sleeve rectangles, a fine hem microprint line. white background.

images.caption: Back close-up: ransom-note NARDWUAR!! over number 97 built from record sleeves on red-green tartan
images.prompt: Close-up technical illustration of the jersey back nameplate and number, the nameplate "NARDWUAR!!" in chaotic cut-and-paste ransom-note type, the number "97" built from tiny record-sleeve and zine-panel rectangles, tartan-red and green on the jersey body. white background.

images.caption: Red tartan jersey flat covered in layered punk-flyer collage with photo-mosaic 26 number
images.prompt: A layered wall of photocopied punk show flyers, overlapping, stapled and torn, riso red and green ink, microtype gig listings and venue names, underground archive texture, xerox grit. No faces.

images.caption: Cream newsprint jersey flats with microtext columns, plaid bands, and NARDWUAR 26 record-sleeve number
images.prompt: A repeating layer of tiny monospace microtext, faint underground-history notes and interview quotes, tonal toner-black on bone, a subtle ornamental document layer. white background.

stages.title: On the Body
stages.blurb: Editorial lifestyle — the kit in the world, on people.

images.caption: Nardwuar FC home back — "NARDWUAR!!" ransom-note lettering above a "97" filled with punk-zine and 7-inch record collage, on red-green Vancouver tartan
Nardwuar FC lifestyle editorial — model on-body in the tartan kit, multi-panel layout, "NARDWUAR FC / everyone else made a souvenir, we made the receipt"
Nardwuar FC three colorways on mannequins in a lit display hall — red home, black/tartan away, white-and-gold third
Vancouver '26 presentation collateral: tartan kit, metal mic crest coin, broadcast credential lanyard
images.prompt: Flat lay of official-looking tournament home-kit marketing materials, bold primary-colour sports branding, crisp broadcast polish, metallic crest mockups and classic striping on a presentation card, red/green/yellow palette. No real logos.

images.caption: Folded tartan tee lifestyle shot among 7-inch record sleeves, cassettes, and a media-accreditation pass
images.prompt: Flat-lay collage of vintage 7-inch vinyl record labels and cassette J-card spines, hand-lettered and typeset, faded ink, tartan-red and green accents, spindle holes and tape reels, crate-digging music-archive texture. No faces.

images.caption: Flat-lay of red tartan jersey with "VANCOUVER" wordmark plus collateral: crest patches, mic/cassette/record swatches, buttons
images.prompt: Flat lay of official-looking tournament home-kit marketing materials, bold primary-colour sports branding, crisp broadcast polish, metallic crest mockups and classic striping on a presentation card, red/green/yellow palette. Any jersey shown reads VANCOUVER across the chest (not a club name). No real logos.

images.caption: Lifestyle — youth in red home jersey in rainy neon-lit Gastown alley
images.prompt: Editorial lifestyle photograph of a generic young person wearing the tartan-red Vancouver soccer jersey, standing in a gritty Gastown brick alley at dusk, rainy neon reflections on wet cobblestone, candid confident pose, 35mm film-grain editorial fashion photography, moody cinematic light. Generic anonymous diverse model, not resembling any real person, not styled as Nardwuar. Photoreal.

images.caption: Lifestyle — fan in red home jersey crate-digging in a record shop
images.prompt: Editorial lifestyle photograph of a generic young person wearing the tartan-red Vancouver soccer jersey, flipping through vinyl crates in a cramped independent Vancouver record shop, warm tungsten light, stacks of 7-inch singles and band flyers behind, candid documentary fashion photography, film grain. Generic anonymous diverse model, not resembling any real person, not styled as Nardwuar. Photoreal.
